titolo: Leafminer
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Azerbaijan, Bahrain, Egypt, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Israel, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates
descrizione: This threat actor targets government organizations and entities in the financial, petrochemical, and transportation sectors for espionage purposes.

titolo: Compromises of government embassies, telecommunications companies, and a Russian oil company
paesi_vittima: Pakistan, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Turkey
descrizione: A group has attacked 131 victims in thirty organizations since September 2018, including unidentified government embassies, telecommunications firms, and a Russian oil and gas company.

titolo: Agrius
descrizione: Agrius is an Iranian threat actor which has consistently been observed targeting Israeli networks. The group has frequently deployed wipers disguised as ransomware on networks, with the goal of destroying data and disrupting operations. Also known as BlackShadow, Americium, Pink Sandstorm, and DEV-0227.

titolo: Storm-842
descrizione: Void Manticore is an Iranian threat actor affiliated with the ministry of intelligence and security. Known to conduct data destruction and espionage attacks, it has been identified in attacks against Albania and Israel.

titolo: Targeting of Israeli organizations
descrizione: Cybersecurity company Check Point Research identified Storm-842 (Void Manticore) for using a custom wiper known as the BiBi wiper, after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The group is known to collaborate with Scarred Manticore, another Iran-sponsored threat actor.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. Departments of Treasury and State, defense contractors, and two New York–based companies
descrizione: Four Iranian nationals (Hossein Harooni, Reza Kazemifar, Komeil Baradaran Salmani, and Alireza Shafie Nasab) were members of a hacking organization from 2016 to 2021 that targeted U.S. companies and the Departments of Treasury and State. The group’s private-sector victims were mainly defense contractors with security clearance. Their primary techniques were spear phishing and social engineering.

titolo: Targeting of telecommunications firms and government agencies in Israel, Turkey, and Africa
descrizione: MuddyWater APT, an Iranian threat actor, launched attacks in February 2024, gaining administrator privileges to upload, extract, monitor, and execute files. Identified by the National Cyber Directorate of Israel in March 2024, the group has been targeting entities aligned with Iran’s political interests.

titolo: Targeting of the telecommunications sector in Egypt, Sudan, and Tanzania
paesi_vittima: Egypt, Sudan, Tanzania, United Republic of
descrizione: Iranian threat actor Muddywater targeted the telecommunications sector in Egypt, Sudan, and Tanzania in November 2023.

titolo: Targeting of Israeli education and technology sectors
descrizione: Agrius, an Iranian threat actor, broke into the networks of Israeli education and technology companies, stole intellectual property, and then deployed wipers on the affected systems to cover their tracks. The attacks began in January 2023 and lasted until at least October 2023.

titolo: Targeting of satellite, defense, and pharmaceutical organizations
descrizione: APT 33 was observed using password-spraying attacks against a wide range of organizations. Microsoft said it detected successful intrusions in a small number of cases and that when APT 33 did gain access to networks, it exfiltrated information from victim servers.

titolo: Targeting of government employees and researchers
descrizione: An Iranian threat actor used LinkedIn to target Israeli government officials and researchers.

titolo: Targeting of organizations in Brazil, Israel, and the United Arab Emirates
descrizione: APT 35 deployed a new backdoor, dubbed Sponsor, against organizations in Brazil, Israel, and the United Arab Emirates. APT 35 appears to have tried to gain access to a wide variety of systems, which suggests that the campaign was aimed at gathering intelligence widely, rather than attacking a specific organization.

titolo: Targeting of nuclear security experts in phishing campaign
paesi_vittima: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Iranian hackers sent phishing emails purporting to be from a senior fellow at the Royal United Services Institute. The campaign’s intent appears to be to learn more about the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action negotiations over Iran’s nuclear program.

titolo: Targeting of users of Israeli shipping and logistics websites
descrizione: An Iranian threat actor perpetrated a watering hole attack using eight Israeli websites. The websites belonged to companies from the shipping, logistics, and financial services industries.

titolo: Targeting of PaperCut MF and NG print management servers by an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps–affiliated actor
descrizione: Charming Kitten targeted vulnerabilities in PaperCut MF and NG print management servers with ransomware.

titolo: Targeting of PaperCut MF and NG print management servers by a Ministry of Intelligence and Security–affiliated actor
descrizione: MuddyWater targeted vulnerabilities in PaperCut MF and NG print management servers with ransomware.

titolo: Targeting of minority groups in Iran
descrizione: The Iranian government is using BoldSpy malware to surveil minority groups in the country and monitor arms, alcohol, and drugs trafficking. The Law Enforcement Command of the Islamic Republic of Iran likely installs the malware, probably using physical access to victim devices it obtains during targets’ detention.

titolo: Targeting of high-profile government, aviation, energy, telecoms and banking-sector entities in the Middle East and North Africa
paesi_vittima: Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bahrain, Canada, Egypt, Israel, Jordan, Kuwait, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, Syrian Arab Republic, Turkey, United Arab Emirates
descrizione: MuddyWater ran a phishing campaign that likely began in July 2021 against high-profile government, aviation, banking-sector, energy, and telecommunications entities in the Middle East and North Africa.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. critical infrastructure and civil-society groups
descrizione: Iranian state-sponsored actor Charming Kitten has been linked to attacks on the U.S. critical infrastructure from 2021 to mid-2022. Those attacks weaponized n-day vulnerabilities on a number of targets, including activists, journalists, the defense industrial base, political dissidents, and U.S. government employees.

titolo: Targeting of the Technion, the Israeli Institute of Technology
descrizione: Iranian threat actor MuddyWater launched a ransomware attack against the Technion in February 2023, forcing the school to delay its final exams by several days.

titolo: Targeting of the Iranian government
descrizione: Mirage, a Chinese threat actor, deployed a new backdoor, dubbed Turian, against the Iranian government in 2022. What agencies in the Iranian government were compromised, or what information Mirage found, is unclear.

titolo: Targeting of activists at Human Rights Watch, journalists, and politicians
descrizione: Iran-affiliated threat actor Charming Kitten conducted a social-engineering and credential-phishing campaign targeting two Human Rights Watch staff members and at least eighteen other high-profile activists, journalists, researchers, academics, diplomats, and politicians working on Middle East issues in 2022.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. federal agency
descrizione: Iran-affiliated group Nemesis Kitten targeted an unnamed U.S. federal agency, though suspected to be the U.S. Merit Systems Protections Board, and installed cryptocurrency-mining software into the government agency’s network.

titolo: Targeting of Iranian citizens
descrizione: Iranian state-sponsored hacking group Prince of Persia targeted Iranian citizens for mobile surveillance by masking malware as an application that translates documents from English to Persian.

titolo: Targeting of medical professionals
descrizione: As part of a larger Iranian espionage campaign against medical professionals, TA453 targeted an individual with a spear-phishing lure to gain access to their credentials. The earlier campaign, known as BadBlood, targeted researchers in the United States and Israel, although the location of the researcher targeted in this latest attack remains unclear.

titolo: Targeting of nuclear security researcher
descrizione: An expert in nuclear security was targeted as part of an Iranian spear-phishing campaign. The threat actors conversed at length with the target via email before sending a malicious document to the researcher.

titolo: APT 42
paesi_vittima: Australia, Bulgaria, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Israel, Italy, Malaysia, Norway, Qatar, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: APT 42 has a wide variety of targets and typically aims to access the networks of organizations and individuals who oppose the Iranian regime. Some overlap also exists between APT 42 and an Iranian-sponsored ransomware actor, UNC2448.

titolo: Targeting of organizations in an Iranian ransomware campaign
descrizione: Charming Kitten launched ransomware attacks against multiple organizations.

titolo: Targeting of Israeli organizations using SysAid
descrizione: MuddyWater discovered a new way to utilize the Log4Shell vulnerability in attacks. The group used the Log4Shell bug in SysAid software, a commonly used IT management and help-desk tool, to access the networks of Israeli organizations.

titolo: Targeting of Albanian government
descrizione: Iranian threat actors targeted Albanian government networks with ransomware. The attack appears to have been motivated by Albania’s hosting a conference for the People’s Mojahedin Organization of Iran, a group previously listed as a terrorist organization by the European Union (EU) and United States and dedicated to opposing the Iranian regime.

titolo: Targeting of UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL)
descrizione: The Israeli defense minister has accused Iran and Hezbollah of attempting a cyberattack against the UNIFIL to steal information about its activities within southern Lebanon.

titolo: Targeting of Middle Eastern countries
descrizione: Since the last quarter of 2020, MuddyWater has maintained a campaign targeting countries in the Middle East. Samples of attacks were gathered from November 2020 to January 2022, but given the more recent samples found, this campaign could be currently active.

titolo: Targeting of high-level U.S. and Israeli officials
descrizione: Lyceum, an Iranian threat actor, used a newly developed and customized .NET-based malware that targeted government officials across the Middle East.

titolo: Targeting of Boston Children’s Hospital
descrizione: Iranian government-backed hackers are believed to have launched a ransomware attack against the Boston Children’s Hospital in the summer of 2021. The attack was foiled after a partner country shared intelligence with the FBI.

titolo: Targeting of Jordanian government
descrizione: Iranian threat actor APT 34 targeted Jordanian officials with the novel backdoor Saitama, which abuses the domain name system (DNS) protocol for command and control communications. Masquerading as the Government of Jordan, APT 34 sent an email via Microsoft Outlook with a malicious Excel document that contained the Saitama backdoor to other officials in the […]

titolo: Targeting   of entities   in Turkey   and the   Arabian   Peninsula
descrizione: MuddyWater conducted a campaign targeting entities in Turkey and the Arabian Peninsula with malicious files used to deliver a remote access Trojan called SloughRAT to victim’s computers. These attacks, though distinct, are related to the January 2022 MuddyWater campaign targeting the Turkish government, leading experts to conclude that this Iranian APT is comprised of multiple teams operating independently.

titolo: Targeting of VMWare Horizon servers with Log4Shell vulnerability
descrizione: The Iranian threat actor APT 35 leveraged the Log4Shell vulnerability to run malicious PowerShell commands, deploy backdoors, steal credentials, and move laterally through systems.

titolo: Targeting of Turkish government organizations
descrizione: The Iranian threat actor MuddyWater sent malicious PDFs and Microsoft Office documents posing as the Turkish Health and Interior Ministries. The campaign targeted government entities including the Scientific and Technological Research Council of Turkey (TUBITAK).

titolo: Targeting of Israeli companies and government agencies
descrizione: An Iranian-linked threat actor was detected exploiting a new vulnerability in the open-source Log4j software to attack at least seven Israeli companies and government agencies.

titolo: Targeting of Asian airline
descrizione: An Iranian threat actor was found using a backdoor against an Asian airline in the summer of 2021. The attackers used Slack as the command and control hub for the backdoor they had inserted, the first observation of the use of the workplace messaging application in such a way by a state-sponsored actor.

titolo: Targeting of telecommunication companies in Asia and the Middle East
paesi_vittima: Israel, Jordan, Kuwait, Lao People's Democratic Republic, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Thailand, United Arab Emirates
descrizione: Iran launched an espionage campaign directed against telecommunication companies throughout Asia and the Middle East. The attacks could have been aimed at inserting malware into the supply chain, although the exact purpose is unclear.

titolo: Emennet Pasargad
descrizione: An Iranian company hired by the Iranian government to interfere in U.S. elections. Emennet Pasargad has attacked voting-related websites and news outlets and distributed misinformation designed to undermine confidence in the U.S. electoral system.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. newspaper chain
descrizione: Iranian hackers are accused of compromising a major U.S. newspaper before the 2020 election.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. and Australian critical infrastructure
descrizione: Iranian hackers have been penetrating networks in both the United States and Australia with ransomware, either to disrupt critical infrastructure or turn a profit.

titolo: MalKamak
descrizione: MalKamak was first discovered conducting a long-term espionage campaign against aerospace and telecommunication companies using Dropbox servers to stealthily exfiltrate data.

titolo: Targeting of major aerospace companies in the United States, Russia, Europe, and the Middle East
descrizione: An Iranian-linked threat actor dubbed MalKamak used a remote access Trojan (RAT) known as ShellClient to target aerospace and telecommunication companies. The RAT employed had been in development since at least 2018 and piggybacked off of Dropbox servers.

titolo: Targeting of Israeli software supply chain
descrizione: An Iranian threat actor is believed to be responsible for using fake job offers to gain access to the email systems of major Israeli software companies. After gaining access to a system, the threat actor would install a backdoor to gain further information from the company’s system or to launch phishing attacks.

titolo: Siamesekitten
descrizione: Siamesekitten was first detected using fake job postings and applications to phish software engineers in Israel. The attacker’s goal appeared to be to escalate access once it had compromised the initial networks and to launch phishing attacks against other individuals and organizations. The malware toolkit used in Siamesekitten’s attacks is geared towards reconnaissance.

titolo: Targeting of Iranian reformists
descrizione: Iranian-linked threat actor Charming Kitten deployed Android malware and WhatsApp exploits to spy on reformist politicians within the country. The Android malware, known as LittleLooter, was especially sophisticated and was able to record almost all actions taken on a compromised device.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. defense industry using Facebook
descrizione: Iran was accused of attempting to break into the personal accounts of over two hundred senior defense personnel in the United States and United Kingdom. The individuals were targeted in phishing attacks.

titolo: Targeting of academics focusing on the Middle East
descrizione: Charming Kitten was found using spear-phishing attacks against UK experts who study the Middle East. The attacks involved impersonating scholars from the University of London’s School of Oriental and African Studies and prompted the victims to either turn over sensitive information or download malware onto their systems.

titolo: Targeting of Lebanese job seekers
descrizione: Lebanese job seekers were sent a compromised pdf document claiming to be an offer from an American IT firm. The exact targets of this phishing campaign remain unclear.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. and Israeli medical researchers
descrizione: The Iranian threat actor Charming Kitten targeted medical researchers in the United States and Israel with spear-phishing techniques. The threat actor used a malicious Gmail account masquerading as a prominent Israeli physicist to trick targets into downloading malware.

titolo: Targeting of Middle Eastern and Azerbaijani organizations
descrizione: Iran-linked hackers used spear-phishing emails to distribute malware to organizations in the Middle East and Azerbaijan.

titolo: Targeting of Dutch data center
descrizione: Iranian-backed hackers compromised a server in a Dutch data center to spy on Iranian dissidents.

titolo: Targeting of United Arab Emirates government employees
descrizione: Iranian threat actor Static Kitten used malicious executables and URLs that impersonated Kuwait’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs to install remote management tool ScreenConnect onto Emirati government computers. The primary objective of the campaign was likely data theft.

titolo: Domestic Kitten
descrizione: Iranian APT believed to be primarily involved in domestic surveillance.

titolo: Targeting of domestic citizens in Iran
descrizione: Iranian APT Domestic Kitten used spyware FurBall to surveil domestic citizens and anyone considered a threat to Tehran. Campaigns have been ongoing since 2017, with the latest launched in November 2020.

titolo: Targeting of Think20 Summit and Munich Security Conference attendees
descrizione: Iranian hackers posing as conference organizers sent fraudulent invitations linking to credential-harvesting pages to government officials, policy experts, and academics expected to attend the Think20 Summit and the Munich Security Conference.

titolo: Targeting of Israeli organizations with ransomware
descrizione: Iranian hackers used the PowGoop downloader, delivered through phishing emails, and publicly known Microsoft Exchange server vulnerabilities to deliver Thanos ransomware.

titolo: Targeting of universities in the United States, Canada, Denmark, the Netherlands, Singapore, Sweden, and the United Kingdom
descrizione: Iranian hackers attempted to steal intellectual property and research documents using phishing emails and websites to obtain student and staff credentials.

titolo: Targeting of network technology providers and organizations working with refugees in the Middle East
descrizione: Iranian hacking group MuddyWater exploited known Zerologon vulnerabilities to compromise servers used by organizations working with refugees in the Middle East.

titolo: Targeting of Iranian expats and dissidents
descrizione: Iranian hackers stole personal documents and two-factor authentication codes from SMS messages, recorded phones’ surroundings, and used Telegram phishing accounts to target Iranian expats and dissidents.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. information technology, government, health-care, finance, and media industries
descrizione: Iranian hackers scanned U.S. government and private networks for virtual private network (VPN) and cloud computing vulnerabilities with the aim of exfiltrating data.

titolo: Targeting of the Donald J. Trump presidential campaign
descrizione: Iranian hackers attempted to log into accounts associated with the Trump administration and campaign staff.

titolo: Pioneer Kitten
descrizione: Responsible for gathering sensitive and private information relevant to Iran. In addition to stalking Iranian expats and dissidents, Pioneer Kitten has targeted North American and Israeli technology, government, defense, and healthcare organizations. Pioneer Kitten is unlikely to be an official part of the Iranian government, and is more likely contracted to act on its behalf.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. companies and government agencies
descrizione: Iranian hackers attacked high-end networking equipment with recently reported vulnerabilities that had not yet been patched, providing a “beachhead” for peer hacking groups.

titolo: Targeting of Israeli water management facilities
descrizione: Hackers targeted two water pumps in Galilee and Mateh Yehuda. No real-world effects were reported as a result of the hacking operation. Israel’s government stated that no data had been stolen.

titolo: Targeting of air transportation and government agencies in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia
descrizione: Dating back to 2018, hackers conducted espionage campaigns against air transportation and government agencies in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia.

titolo: Disruption of operations at Shahid Rajaee Port
descrizione: Israel retaliated against Iran for targeting of Israeli water treatment and sewage facilities by launching a cyberattack against Iran’s Shahid Rajaee Port, disrupting its operations.

titolo: Targeting of South Asia telecommunication providers
descrizione: The Greenbug group used off-the-shelf tools and living-off-the-land techniques to gain access to South Asian telecommunication providers’ database servers.

titolo: Attack on Israeli water utilities
descrizione: Iranian hackers sought to cripple computers that control water flow and wastewater treatment for two rural districts in Israel. Israeli officials reported that the attack was quickly detected and defeated, preventing harm to water supplies.

titolo: Distribution of malware through Google Play store
paesi_vittima: Algeria, Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, South Africa, Vietnam
descrizione: The Vietnam-linked threat group uploaded malware-infected apps to the Google Play store to trick users into downloading them onto their phones.

titolo: Targeting of World Health Organization (WHO) Staff Emails
descrizione: Hackers sent phishing emails masquerading as Google web services to WHO employees, attempting to gain access to internal information.

titolo: Targeting of companies in the United States, Israel, Saudi Arabia, and elsewhere
descrizione: The Iranian threat actors targeted dozens of companies in the United States, Israel, Saudi Arabia, and elsewhere. They exploited VPNs for initial access and breached additional companies via supply chain attacks.

titolo: Fox Kitten
descrizione: Responsible for targeting unpatched network equipment belonging to U.S. government agencies and private companies.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. government employees
descrizione: The Iranian state-backed hackers sent out sophisticated spear-phishing lures imitating Westat, a research services company, in hopes of compromising U.S. government employees and networks. They could have also intended to compromise actual Westat employees.

titolo: Impersonation of journalists to compromise public figures
paesi_vittima: Germany, Israel, Saudi Arabia, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: The Iranian state-backed threat actor Charming Kitten impersonated prominent journalists and sent targets fake interview requests in order to steal their credentials and send them malware.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. grid
descrizione: The Iranian hackers APT 33 targeted the U.S. electric grid with password-spraying attacks, likely in an attempt to gain access. They targeted only the IT side of networks so far and have not proven their ability to access physical systems.

titolo: Compromise of Bapco
descrizione: The Iranian state-backed hackers installed malware on the network of Bapco, Bahrain’s national oil producer. The malware, called Dustman, used a wiper functionality, but experts suspect this could have been meant to erase itself after being discovered.

titolo: Targeting of Middle Eastern oil companies
descrizione: Using a new wiper malware called ZeroCleare, Iranian-linked threat actor APT 34 (aka Oilrig) targeted oil companies in the Middle East.

titolo: Targeting of industrial control systems
descrizione: Iran-aligned threat actor APT 33 targeted industrial control system manufacturers, suppliers, and maintainers.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. government and private entities and other victims
descrizione: The Iran-aligned espionage group APT 33 used botnets to launch a campaign against a small number of victims in the public and private sectors in the United States, Asia, and the Middle East.

titolo: DarkUniverse
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Belarus, Ethiopia, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Russian Federation, Sudan, Syrian Arab Republic, Tanzania, United Republic of, United Arab Emirates
descrizione: DarkUniverse was a threat group affiliated with Russia that was active for at least eight years, from 2009 until 2017.

titolo: U.S. retaliation against Iran
descrizione: The United States carried out a cyberattack against Iran designed to limit Tehran’s ability to spread propaganda in retaliation for the September 14 attacks on Saudi oil facilities.

titolo: Targeting of a U.S. presidential campaign
descrizione: A threat actor targeted the email accounts of an unnamed U.S. presidential campaign, current and former U.S. officials and journalists, and others. During a thirty-day period in August and September, Microsoft observed more than 2,700 attempts to identify the emails of specific customers and 241 hacks.  Four accounts were compromised, though not those connected to […]

titolo: Attack on U.S. presidential campaign government officials, journalists, and prominent expatriate Iranians
descrizione: Iranian threat actor Phosphorus attacked 241 email accounts associated with a U.S. presidential campaign government officials, and journalists, and prominent expatriate Iranians.

titolo: Targeting of over sixty universities in multiple countries, including the United States and United Kingdom
paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, Hong Kong, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: A threat actor launched a phishing operation with spoofed login pages to steal the credentials of users at over sixty universities in the United States, United Kingdom, and elsewhere.

titolo: Compromise of Bahraini government agencies and critical infrastructure
descrizione: A threat actor broke into the systems of Bahrain’s National Security Agency, Ministry of Interior, and office of the first deputy prime minister. On July 25, 2019, Bahraini authorities detected intrusions into its electric and water authority that shut down several systems. The attacks were similar to two hacks in 2012, in which the Shamoon […]

titolo: Attack on Iranian computer systems
descrizione: U.S. Cyber Command hacked Iranian rocket and missile launch systems in retaliation for the downing of a U.S. drone and attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian officials said the attack was not successful.

titolo: Attacks on private U.S. companies
descrizione: This threat actor increased malicious activity targeting U.S. companies following a U.S. attack on Iranian computer systems.

titolo: Compromise of British infrastructure
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the British Post Office and local government networks, stealing personal data—including email addresses and mobile phone numbers—of thousands of employees.

titolo: Global hijacking of domain name system (DNS)
paesi_vittima: Canada, Korea (Republic of), Lebanon, United Arab Emirates, United States
descrizione: An unknown actor with a connection to Iran hijacked DNS records to target the traffic of governments and telecommunications organizations around the world.

titolo: Attack on Italian oil firm Saipem
paesi_vittima: India, Italy, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom
descrizione: An attack on the Italian oil firm Saipem targeted servers based in India, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Scotland, and the United Arab Emirates. Hackers used a variant of the Shamoon virus.

titolo: APT 39
paesi_vittima: Australia, Egypt, Iraq, Korea (Republic of), Norway, Saudi Arabia, Spain, Turkey
descrizione: This threat actor, operating since November 2014, focuses on the Middle East. It mainly targets the telecommunications industry, and also targets the travel industry and supporting IT firms, and the high-tech industry.

titolo: Cobalt Dickens
paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, China, Israel, Japan, Switzerland, Turkey, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets universities around the world for espionage purposes.

titolo: Operation Parliament
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Canada, Chile, Denmark, Djibouti, Egypt, Germany, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Iraq, Israel, Jordan, Korea (Republic of), Kuwait, Lebanon, Morocco, Oman, Palestine, State of, Qatar, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Serbia, Somalia, Syrian Arab Republic, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor uses spear-phishing techniques to target parliaments, government ministries, academics, and media organizations, primarily in the Middle East, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Indictment of officials from the Mabna Institute
paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Korea (Republic of), Malaysia, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: The U.S. Department of Justice indicted nine officials from the Mabna Insititute, an Iranian company alleged to have conducted state-sponsored cyber operations on behalf of the Iranian Revolutionary Guards. They are alleged to have compromised the networks of over 144 U.S. universities, 176 universities in over twenty-one other countries, as well as private sector, government, […]

titolo: Iron Tiger
paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, China, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Israel, Japan, Korea (Republic of), Russian Federation, Taiwan, Thailand, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets governments as well as technology, education, and telecommunications companies primarily in Asia and the United States, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: APT 35
descrizione: This threat actor, whose activities date back to 2014, conducts long-term operations to collect strategic intelligence. They target U.S. and Middle Eastern defense, diplomatic, and government personnel, as well as private industries, including media, energy, business services, and telecommunications.

titolo: APT 34
descrizione: This threat actor targets organizations in the financial, energy, government, chemical, and telecommunications sectors worldwide for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: MuddyWater
paesi_vittima: Georgia, India, Iraq, Israel, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets governments, primarily in the Middle East and South Asia, for espionage purposes.

titolo: APT 33
paesi_vittima: Korea (Republic of), Saudi Arabia, United States
descrizione: This threat actor is an Iranian state-sponsored APT that targets private-sector entities in the aviation, energy, and petrochemical sectors for the purpose of espionage. It first became active in late 2015 or early 2016, and has been involved in a three-year campaign against multiple firms in the United States and Saudi Arabia. On December 19, […]

titolo: CopyKittens
paesi_vittima: Germany, Israel, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets government institutions, universities, defense contractors, and large IT companies for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Attempted compromise of email accounts associated with the UK Parliament
descrizione: A threat actor attempted to gain access to email accounts associated with members and other staffers of the British Parliament. The incident, originally believed to be the work of Russian or North Korean actors, was later attributed to Iran.

titolo: Magic Hound
descrizione: This threat actor targets entities in the government, energy, and technology sectors that are located in or do business with Saudi Arabia.

titolo: Greenbug
descrizione: Greenbug is believed to be an Iranian threat actor with ties to the group behind the Shamoon malware. It has previously used off-the-shelf tools and living-off-the-land techniques to gain access to South Asian telecommunication companies’ servers. It has also used custom remote access trojans (RAT) to steal information and credentials from Middle Eastern targets.

titolo: Project Sauron
paesi_vittima: Belgium, China, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Russian Federation, Rwanda, Sweden
descrizione: This threat actor compromises targets in the Military, telecommunications, and financial sectors in Belgium, China, Iran, Russia, Sweden, and elsewhere.

titolo: Operation Mermaid
descrizione: This threat actor is based in the Middle East (possibly Iran) and targets English- and Persian-language organizations. It is alleged to be the same group behind a compromise of the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

titolo: OilRig
paesi_vittima: Israel, Kuwait, Lebanon, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United States
descrizione: A threat actor believed to be Iran that targets private-sector and government entities for the purpose of espionage. In October 2019, revealed to have been compromised by Turla. Some operations previously attributed to the group may be Turla false flags.

titolo: Chafer
paesi_vittima: Israel, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, United Arab Emirates
descrizione: This threat actor targets organizations in the aerospace, technology, telecommunications, and engineering sectors for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Compromise of social media accounts of State Department officials
descrizione: A threat actor compromised social media accounts of junior State Department staff to launch spear-phishing campaigns for espionage purposes.

titolo: Rocket Kitten
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Canada, Egypt, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Iraq, Israel, Jordan, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Syrian Arab Republic, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, Yemen
descrizione: This threat actor targets defense contractors and academic institutions in Israel, European government agencies, and civil society actors. It seeks out material related to diplomacy, defense, security, journalism, and human rights for espionage purposes.

titolo: Duqu 2.0
descrizione: A threat actor, using a tool dubbed Duqu 2.0, targeted individuals and companies linked to the P5+1 (the five permanent member states of the UN Security Council, plus Germany), which was conducting negotiations on Iran’s nuclear program.

titolo: Compromise of networks in the Saudi government ministries
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the networks of several Saudi government ministries for the purposes of espionage and doxing.

titolo: Equation Group
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Algeria, China, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Kenya, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Pakistan, Russian Federation, Syrian Arab Republic, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, Yemen
descrizione: In 2015, Moscow-based Kaspersky Lab published a report on the Equation Group, a threat actor active since 2001 [PDF]. It was responsible for infecting approximately five hundred systems in at least forty-two countries. The malware used by Equation Group had the ability to reprogram hard drives and then self-destruct, which made the operations effectively invisible […]

titolo: Compromise of the Sands Casino
descrizione: Threat actors launched a denial of service attack and wiped data from the computer networks at the Sands Casino in Las Vegas.

titolo: Operation Cleaver
paesi_vittima: Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Israel, Korea (Republic of), Kuwait, Mexico, Pakistan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets governments and private sector entities for espionage and sabotage purposes. titolo: Flame

descrizione: A threat actor, using a tool called Flame, targeted computers in the Middle East region; the most compromises were in Iran. This compromise gained widespread coverage due to the modular nature of the malware the threat actors used.

titolo: Attempted compromise of the BBC Persian TV service
